validated_multimodal_directions: PLIM paired RGB+IR predictive latent identity association
classification.not_multimodal: Phase VI A/B/C recoverability, risk/memory protection, and candidate-residual modules read RGB-only current-frame coordinates
classification.modality_boundary: IR is causally constructed from RGB; results support conditional representation/optimization claims, not independent thermal-sensor information.

conclusion.reason: RGB+IR predictive is only +0.2123 HOTA over two-RGB predictive, essentially matches the lower-capacity ordinary single-RGB GRU, while CMUE is near a ranking-free constant-IR control and rejects all IR rows in the final joint audit.
conclusion.recommended_claim: The implementation demonstrates a testable conditional RGB/synthetic-IR fusion mechanism and recoverable negative evidence; it does not yet validate an IR-specific improvement over strong RGB/capacity controls.
